component.name: Demios Desktop
component.summary: Chat with local or cloud AI models

description.p: Demios Desktop is an open-source app for chatting with AI models.

ul.li: Run models on your computer. Download a model from the built-in list, or GGUF models from Hugging Face, and chat with them through llama.cpp. The app shows whether it fits in your computer’s memory and its licence before you download it.
Or bring your own key. Add an API key for Anthropic, OpenAI or Google Gemini and chat with their models under your own account and their terms.
See what the model makes. Web pages, small apps, diagrams and documents open next to the chat, run sealed off from your computer, and keep every version.
Give models tools. Add remote tool servers (MCP). Tools that change something show exactly what they will do and wait for your OK.

Your data stays with you. There is no Demios account and no Demios server. Chats and settings stay on your computer, keys stay in your system keyring, and the app collects no usage data. Delete all local data removes everything the app stored, in one step.

description.p: This version runs in the Flatpak sandbox, so it connects to remote (HTTPS) tool servers only and can’t start programs on your computer.
Answers come from the AI model you chose and can be wrong. Check important facts.

description.p: First version, not released yet. It includes:

ul.li: Chat with streamed answers, Markdown and highlighted code; stop, retry and copy answers
Models on your computer from a built-in list or Hugging Face, checked against their SHA-256 before use
Your own API key for Anthropic, OpenAI or Google Gemini, kept in your system keyring
Artifacts: web pages, small apps, diagrams and documents in a sandboxed side pane, with every version kept
Remote tool servers (MCP) with approval for tools that change something
Delete all local data, and a list of the open-source licences of every package shipped
